name: my-pi-tools
description: Pi extensions for code navigation, web search, read-only help and prompt profiles; host tools for skills, CLIs, model catalogs and CLIProxyAPI

scripts.check: npm --prefix codegraph run typecheck && npm --prefix search run typecheck && npm --prefix helper run check && npm --prefix prompt-profile run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --prefix codegraph test && npm --prefix search test && npm --prefix helper test && npm --prefix prompt-profile test && npm run test:skills && npm run test:models
scripts.test:models: node --test models-updater/test/*.test.mjs && python3 -B -m unittest discover -s models-updater/test -p 'test_*.py' -v
